defects.canonical: safe_join canonicalizes with os.path.abspath, which resolves '..' and absolute components but NOT symlinks. A symlinked component inside base that points outside it yields a candidate still under base_prefix, so the prefix check passes and the escape is allowed. The documented contract promises a symlink-resolved path; os.path.realpath is required to honor it.
defects.why_subtle: abspath looks like the right canonicalizer and handles the '..' and prefix cases the comments discuss; only knowing abspath ignores symlinks while realpath follows them reveals the hole.
